scope: Trinidad and Tobago medical discovery — University of the West Indies St. Augustine MBBS

verifiedFacts.claim: UWI St. Augustine's 2025/26 Faculty of Medical Sciences regulations state that MBBS graduates must complete a one-year internship to be eligible to practise and obtain full registration with the Medical Board of Trinidad and Tobago.
UWI St. Augustine's official undergraduate admissions page sets the 2026/27 application cycle from 5 January to 17 July 2026.
UWI's fee guidance says undergraduate fees are credit-based and identifies compulsory fees including guild, ID, caution money, group health plan, personal accident insurance and student amenities.

The Medical Board of Trinidad and Tobago states that satisfactory completion of UWI Doctor of Medicine programmes qualifies foreign applicants for automatic full registration under the referenced Board policy.

holdReasons: No complete, current 2026/27 MBBS fee card was located; generic credit-based fee guidance cannot become a programme fee figure.

The general 2026/27 admissions page does not provide the complete MBBS-specific academic requirements, selection mechanics, deadline distinctions, intake capacity or international-applicant requirements.
Current MBBS duration/curriculum, named clinical sites, accommodation, scholarship/loan support and the precise scope of graduate registration require programme-specific verification.
nextAction: Obtain UWI's current MBBS programme page, detailed admissions criteria and 2026/27 fee schedule, then verify clinical training and support before considering a payload.
